test-local.purpose: Docker-free Java, Spring Boot/HSQLDB, forked restart and real local Chrome scenarios; reuses existing tests without adding a duplicate CI lane
requires: Matching Chrome and ChromeDriver (CHROME_BIN and CHROMEDRIVER)

ci.purpose: Required pull-request verification: unit tests, core, PostgreSQL and Keycloak integration tests, quality gates, browser matrix and accessibility audit

plugin-packaging-tests.purpose: Independent SDK plugin build, immutable host, authenticated HTTP and physically optional feature combinations; also owned by canonical CI

document-template-report-e2e.purpose: Packaged application, PostgreSQL Testcontainers, Playwright requirement evaluation, report download and rendered document evidence

reformulation-usage-tests.purpose: Scoped durable usage, recovery, encoding and repository-guard regression tests; supplements canonical CI

reformulation-real-llm.purpose: Explicit opt-in five-case real-provider walk-up versus complete-prompt comparison; human quality review remains separate

scenario-acceptance.purpose: Sourced Copilot scenario with Spring remote LLM playback, export semantics and real browser screenshots
requires: Docker or test-local with matching Chrome and ChromeDriver

supply-chain-policy.purpose: Focused repository scan for immutable external GitHub Action commits and production image digests

jgit-storage-hibernate-contract.purpose: Bounded consumer-owned Core schema, Hibernate Search and PostgreSQL compatibility contract for jgit-storage-hibernate upgrades

keycloak-security.purpose: Imported-realm browser OIDC, bearer JWT, CSRF, role, Swagger, logout and health verification
